remarks: Experience this comfortable yet cozy dual-suite residence featuring a highly desirable, thoughtfully laid-out split-bedroom configuration that maximizes your usable square footage. As a private front corner unit in a small, exceptionally quiet complex on a tree-lined residential street, this home anchors its open-concept kitchen and living spaces in a bright central core, flanked by two private ensuite bedrooms. Inside, the tranquil interior is filled with dappled sunlight streaming through the trees, highlighting smooth ceilings, fresh paint, and engineered hardwood floors.
